name: Ref-DVGO
definition: A reflection-aware neural rendering method that combines the fast hybrid implicit-explicit representation of DVGO with the reflection direction reparameterization of Ref-NeRF to achieve high-quality photorealistic novel view synthesis of reflective scenes with reduced training and rendering time.
summary: Ref-DVGO is a fast, memory-efficient neural rendering method for reflective scenes that replaces large MLPs with voxel grids to reduce training time while maintaining high-quality photorealism.
